saints.name: St. Gregory of Nyssa
saints.title: Bishop
saints.shortBlurb: The youngest of the Cappadocian Fathers, a mystical theologian and champion of the Nicene faith…
biography: Younger brother of St. Basil the Great, Gregory was born about 335 and, after a period teaching rhetoric, was made bishop of the small town of Nyssa. Deposed and exiled by the Arians, he returned in triumph after the death of the emperor Valens.

At the First Council of Constantinople in 381 he stood among the great defenders of orthodoxy, and his profound writings on the Trinity, the soul, and the ascent of the mind to God mark him as one of the founders of Christian mysticism. He died about 395.
saints.knownFor: His mystical theology and defense of the Nicene Creed.
